speaker: george_bryan
text: You will hear it from the stair if you do not hear it from me. A groom of my lord of Hunsdon's had it, and I had it from him.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am out of Egeon until the end of him. Say it once, George, and I will not have it twice.

speaker: george_bryan
text: My lord of Southampton courts one of the Queen's maids. Mistress Vernon. With too much familiarity, the groom says, and the court says so.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Say it once, then, and leave it. I do not want her name in a book, and I do not want it in a second telling.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The court is always certain. I have had that sentence once today, and I am not adding a better one.

speaker: george_bryan
text: I am not asking you to better it. I am telling you it came up with the hired men's water. He is happy, they say.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then let them keep happy. It is not my suit, and it is not a part. I have a father to finish.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Finish him. George has told you, which is all a groom is worth. I am going to be deaf if it comes round again.

speaker: george_bryan
text: I have told you. God keep you for the last scene.
